study type: Retrospective review (descriptive-analytical study comparing before and after an intervention)
exposure: Implementation of a health improvement program
outcome: Number of cesarean cases due to previous C-section
cohort: The study included 111 neonates with moderate and severe asphyxia born at Bentolhoda Hospital of Bojnurd, Iran, between April 2013 and 2015.
finding: The implementation of the health improvement program reduced the incidence of perinatal asphyxia from 1.05% to 0.54% and significantly decreased the mean duration of mechanical ventilation.
mod_finding: The number of cesarean cases due to previous C-section was observed to decrease after the program's implementation.
